story.title: Man Utd beaten by Atletico as Yoro controversially sent off
story.summary: Manchester United failed to ease the pressure on Michael Carrick as they were beaten 2-0 at Atletico Madrid in the Champions League after Leny Yoro’s controversial second-half sending off.
